'''2007 Worlds Team Michael Richards DS Cloud City Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Richards]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Lando's not a system. No numbered Obj; start Downtown Plaza. 10 shields.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Richards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Cloud City: Downtown Plaza|Cloud City: Downtown Plaza]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
